headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time risk assessment features into ClearInstall to provide users with up-to-date information on potential vulnerabilities and risks associated with package installations, including binding.gyp command expansion. This will help ensure a safer development environment for local-first applications.
